description: Set the EU VAT id of a company record. cmssy normalizes it (spaces, dots and dashes dropped, GR read as EL) and checks it against the member state's format; a malformed id is refused (BAD_USER_INPUT). null or empty clears it. A changed id is no longer verified, so its orders are taxed as standard until set_company_vat_verified attests the new value. Needs customers:manage. Verifying the id or exempting the company (set_company_vat_verified, set_company_tax_exemption) needs customers:manage and site:config:edit, and so does linking a customer to a company whose VAT id is verified or that is tax exempt. Refused for a record that is not a company (a model with the Company capability). Returns the record id with vatId, vatCountry, vatVerifiedAt, vatVerifiedBy and taxExemptReason.

recordId.description: The company record's id (a record of a model with the Company capability; a customer's company.id)

vatId.description: The EU VAT id with its country prefix, e.g. DE123456789; null or empty clears it

name: set_company_vat_id
title: Set company vat id
